name: Elpriser i dag API
description:
Quarter-hourly spot prices for the four Swedish bidding zones, with VAT and energy tax already added – the price a household actually pays – and the reduced energy tax for the 46 northern municipalities given separately. Also grid fees (elnätsavgifter) for 188 grid companies, 2022–2026, from Energimarknadsinspektionen.

No key is required. An optional free key raises the hourly limit from 120 to 2000 requests. Field names and notes are in Swedish.

Prices: Nord Pool via elprisetjustnu.se. Grid fees: Energimarknadsinspektionen (Ei). Free to use with a link to elprisernaidag.se.
